svg.title: Saved reports, private or shared with the team — SoftTrack web design mockup (#330)
svg.desc: A report is saved with a name, private to its owner or shared with the team like a saved view, and stored the same way: typed choices and filters with foreign keys. The Reports tab lists the team’s shared reports and your own below the built-in charts; a star opens one first, and a report that loses something it named says so.
svg.text: Saved reports, private or shared with the team
· a report somebody built is still there tomorrow

svg.text: Done when a report saves with a name, private or shared with the team; when its choices and filters are stored as typed columns with foreign keys; when the Reports tab lists
shared and own reports below the built-in charts and a starred one opens first; when a deleted status, label, epic or field drops out of a report with a note and an archived field
keeps working; when owners and team admins edit and others duplicate; and when guests can open shared reports and save nothing.
